description: This file defines the GeolocationService class providing methods to open maps, share location, make phone calls, and open WhatsApp with specified contact details.

classes.name: GeolocationService
classes.description: A service class offering geolocation-related functionalities such as opening map directions, sharing location, calling a phone number, and opening WhatsApp.

methods.name: openDirections
methods.description: Constructs a Google Maps URL with specified latitude and longitude and attempts to open it in an external application.

methods.name: shareLocation
methods.description: Placeholder method to share location, currently redirects to openDirections method.

methods.name: callPhone
methods.description: Constructs a tel: URI using the provided phone number and attempts to initiate a phone call.

methods.name: openWhatsApp
methods.description: Constructs a WhatsApp sending URL tailored for iOS or Android and attempts to open it externally with a message.
